edit.find:
Can be shoved by a body slam/charge attack (playerFlags bit $0002). Once pushed far
enough (checked via position), sets flag $B9 and applies
StandardEnemyDefeatHandler. Before being pushed, takes hits but

edit.with: Every frame the actor compares its HP with $FF. When the HP is still $FF it returns. When the HP differs (a hit landed since the previous frame) it reads playerFlags: with bit $0002 set it sets flag $B9 and jumps to StandardEnemyDefeatHandler (EnemyDefeatFlashAndDrop); with the bit clear it decrements its scratch word $24 and restores the HP to $FF. There is no position test. Measured with an HP poke: bit $0002 set destroys the statue and sets $B9; bit clear resets the HP and changes nothing else. What sets playerFlags bit $0002 during a real hit is not traced.
